titulo: HP Inc. (Nov 2022): $1.1 billion returned to shareholders, about 4,000 jobs cuts planned. The math.
caption:
From the archive: Nov 2022. Not today's news.
HP Inc., Nov 22, 2022 (HP, Form 8-K): "enable digital transformation, portfolio optimization and operational efficiency"
HP's 8-K, filed Nov. 22, 2022, says its board approved a plan to cut about 4,000 to 6,000 employees by fiscal 2025. Its 10-K says HP returned $1.1 billion to shareholders in fiscal 2023.

Fiscal 2023: $1.1 billion returned to shareholders, fiscal 2023. $1.1 billion returned to shareholders in fiscal 2023 (the year that began Nov. 1, 2022): $1.0 billion in cash dividends and $0.1 billion in share repurchases.
The math: $1.1 billion to shareholders (2023) ÷ about 4,000 job cuts = about $275,000 to shareholders per planned job cut.
The facts: $1.1 billion returned to shareholders, fiscal 2023 (HP 10-K, fiscal 2023, Dec 18, 2023). about 4,000 jobs cuts planned by FY2025 (HP 8-K, Item 2.05, Nov 22, 2022). The $1.1 billion is what HP returned to shareholders in fiscal 2023 (the year that began Nov. 1, 2022): $1.0 billion in cash dividends and $0.1 billion in share repurchases. The job count is the low end of HP's planned 4,000 to 6,000 employees by the end of fiscal 2025. At 6,000 the same division gives about $183,333 per job cut.

Efficiency, in the filing. Shareholders, in the column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: HP 8-K, Item 2.05, Nov 22, 2022; HP 10-K, fiscal 2023, Dec 18, 2023.

More at the link in bio.
